title: Analyzing Graphs of Functions
instructions: Answer all questions. For fill‑in‑the‑blank and short‑answer, use one word, letter, or number only.

questions.prompt: The Vertical Line Test helps determine if a graph represents a function. A graph fails the test if a vertical line intersects the graph at:
hints: Think about multiple outputs for a single input.
A function must have exactly one output for each input.
questions.feedbackIfWrong: A graph fails the Vertical Line Test if a vertical line intersects it at more than one point.

questions.prompt: The set of all input values of a function is called the ___.
A graph has domain $ [-4, 3) $. Is $ 3 $ included in the domain? (yes or no)
The zeros of a function are the $ x $-values where:
Find the zeros of $ f(x) = x^2 - 4 $. (list numbers separated by comma, e.g., 2,-2)
A function is increasing on an interval if, as $ x $ increases, $ f(x) $:
questions.feedbackIfWrong: Increasing means $ f(x) $ goes up as $ x $ increases.

questions.prompt: If a graph is flat (horizontal) on an interval, the function is ___ on that interval.
A function has a peak at $ x = 3 $ where $ f(3) = 10 $. This is a relative ___ (minimum or maximum).
Which of the following best describes a relative minimum?
options: The highest point on the entire graph
A point where the function changes from increasing to decreasing
A point where the function changes from decreasing to increasing
hints: Think of the bottom of a valley.
questions.feedbackIfWrong: A relative minimum occurs where the function changes from decreasing to increasing.

questions.prompt: Is the point $ (0,0) $ a relative minimum of $ f(x) = |x| $? (yes or no)
hints: Lowest point is at the vertex.

options: The graph is symmetric about the $ y $-axis
hints: Negating the input negates the output.
questions.feedbackIfWrong: A function is odd if $ f(-x) = -f(x) $.

questions.prompt: The graph of an even function is symmetric about the ___‑axis.
If $ f $ is odd and $ f(4) = -7 $, what is $ f(-4) $? (number only)
The zeros of $ f(x) = \frac{x+3}{x-2} $ occur when $ x = $ ___.
